name: Keepa - Amazon Price Tracker
shortInfo: Improve sales, make better sourcing decisions, include fast selling products in your inventory & keep track of competitors' prices.
brief: Keepa is tracking the products of the Amazon shops in the US, Germany, Great Britain, France, Italy, Spain, Canada, Japan, India, Mexico and Brazil.
about:
Keepa-Amazon Price Tracker monitors, tracks, stores, and displays the data from the pricing and sales rank history for most products being sold on Amazon and gives alerts/notifications of price drops. All products available on Amazon can be tracked, with the rare exception of products with strict marketing regulations and eBooks.

Keepa is tracking the products of the Amazon shops in the US, Germany, Great Britain, France, Italy, Spain, Canada, Japan, India, Mexico and Brazil.

Using this connector will enable online retailers to improve sales, make better sourcing decisions, include fast selling products in your inventory, keep track of competitors' prices.

Read more about it [here](https://keepa.com/#!api).
availableData:
[Deals](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/keepa/pipelines/deals.html)

Deals pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of products that have recently undergone changes, typically in price or sales rank. It contains a summary of the products and information about the changes. This report will return a maximum of 150 deals and can provide up to 10,000 ASINs using paging.

[Bestsellers](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/keepa/pipelines/bestsellers.html)

Bestsellers pipeline can be used to request and retrieve an ASIN list of the most popular products based on sales in a specific category or product group.
